_help.about: Facts the legal pages depend on that nothing in the code can confirm. Josh fills these in. node scripts/check-legal-pages.mjs --publish fails while any value below is null.
_help.legalEntity: Exact legal name and entity type as shown on the Apple seller record and the Google Play developer account, for example "Integrity Quality Solutions LLC". Every legal page, the site footer (site/assets/shared.js) and /terms/ must then use this exact string.
_help.counselReviewedOn: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) counsel approved /privacy/, /subprocessors/ and /delete-account/, including the processor position, the Play Data safety answer and each commitment flagged in the pages.
_help.deletionProcessLive: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) or link showing that a written removal runbook exists matching /delete-account/ and section 09 of /privacy/ (account policy of 2026-09-30): the employer's administrator files the request from Admin > Privacy in the IQS Flow console (an email to privacy@iqsflow.com is answered with a request to file there); IQS acts only when it comes from an active ADMIN of that employer's (vendor or both) account, who is not filing for themselves, and names a member of that account who is already deactivated; within 30 days of filing it removes the person's email address and phone number, sign-in code (last-4 hash), Firebase login, push tokens and that employer's location tracking history; records another employer holds stay until that employer's administrator files its own request; and it leaves work records as they are, with the name and GPS. The runbook is iqs-flow-api docs/runbooks/former-worker-data-removal.md (branch claude/employer-managed-accounts until merged). Also that counsel approved how the append-only audit history keeps a person's details (or that audit entries no longer store them), and settled work orders: deleting one writes a permanent copy to the append-only work_order_deletions table, and a real emergency report cannot be deleted except with the whole employer account (iqs-flow-api migration 20260928150000_next_batch).
_help.appVersionWithGates: App version on every phone that has the scheduled-shift gate on the 3-minute location check-in, a location notice that says who can see your location (your supervisor, coworkers, and your employer's clients at their own sites), and the short explanation that your employer manages your account in place of the Delete my account request (no profile.sendDeleteRequest text), for example "1.1.0". Run the check with --publish --app-locales=<that release's locales folder>.
